_comment: #8 sandbox demo: a deny-list seccomp profile layered on the runtime default. Blocks syscalls an inference server never needs (ptrace, mount, kernel modules, kexec, bpf, keyctl, unshare of user ns). Load as a localhost profile (kubelet seccomp dir) or `docker run --security-opt seccomp=seccomp-inference.json`. For untrusted code execution (tool use, code interpreter) use gVisor (runsc RuntimeClass) or Firecracker microVMs instead: seccomp narrows the kernel surface, it is not an isolation boundary.
